battle.name: 張善安起義
battle.theater: 江右鄱陽尋陽（贛北長江中游）
battle.brief: 大業十三年（617）冬，隋室已自長江下游的江都播遷，天下州縣多為亂兵所據，張善安在鄱陽起兵，攻陷尋陽，自稱都督、置官屬，兵鋒直指江右郡縣；隋廷遣將回討，起義旋即潰散。卡面斯巴達長矛未隨軍而至，但密集槍陣的形制在江右鄉兵的竹槊與隋軍的步槊上都有對應。

kit.name: 斯巴達長矛
kit.history: 兩米長的木槍，槍尾帶銅套。方陣裡它比劍更早決定誰站得住。

countries: 張善安起義爆發於隋煬帝大業十三年（617）的江右，核心在尋陽、鄱陽、饒州一帶，即今江西北部沿長江與鄱陽湖的交通走廊。交戰的一方是張善安為首的起義聯盟：加入者以淪為流民的鄉里百姓、逃散的府兵與郡兵、被裁汰或欠賦的役夫為主，也吸納了地方豪強、宗族首領與亡命之徒，首領自稱都督，攻破州縣之後就地置官屬、徵集糧秣，把原本的州縣衙門換成自己的衙門。另一方是隋朝的正統軍：中央派出的禁軍將領率兵南下，江南各州郡的地方官與郡兵、鄉兵固守城池，豪強提供的部曲與護鹽、運漕的丁役也被編入守軍，長江防線上還有水軍巡弋江面。整體的指揮系統自上而下由居於江都的煬帝以詔令調度，中層依賴郡、縣兩級官吏各自死守；隋廷在兵源枯竭、糧餉無著的狀態下，往往只給出「討捕」這樣的模糊指令，地方各自為戰。同一時期江淮與河北還有杜伏威、沈法興、竇建德、李子通等各據一方，起義彼此聲援卻互不統一，張善安這一線終究只能獨自面對中央的追討。
countriesEn: The Zhang Shan'an rising broke out in 617 CE, the thirteenth year of the Daye era, on the right bank of the middle Yangtze, centred on Xunyang, Poyang and Raozhou — the corridor along the river and the lake in what is now northern Jiangxi. One side was the rebel league led by Zhang Shan'an: its ranks were made up chiefly of peasant refugees, deserters from the state and commandery militia, and men released from or lost to the corvée, together with local landowners, clan heads and fugitives from the law. Having seized a prefecture or county, the leader appointed his own officials, levied grain, and turned the old magistrate's offices into his own administration. The other side was the legitimist army of the Sui: detachments of the central palace guards sent southward, local officials with commandery and county troops holding the walled cities, militia and private retainers supplied by the great landowners, and a river flotilla patrolling the Yangtze. Command ran from the top down: the Yangdi emperor, then established at Jiangdu, issued the orders, while the middle layer was left to the county and district officials, each of whom had to hold his own city. With exhausted manpower and no supplies behind them, the court's dispatches often carried nothing more specific than an order to "suppress the bandits", and the localities fought on their own. Elsewhere in Jianghuai and Hebei, Du Fuwei, Shen Faxing, Dou Jiande, Li Zitong and others were building their own bases; the risings echoed one another but were never unified, and Zhang's line in the end had to face the court's counterattack alone.
people: 這場起義留下名字的人不多，張善安本身的行狀在現存史籍中只剩下寥寥數句：他崛起於鄱陽，攻入尋陽之後自稱都督，設置官屬，把地方秩序重新編排。史家多以「盜」「賊」稱呼這類武裝，記錄多半夾雜在雜記與編年之間，對他的出身、年歲、起兵的具體動機都語焉不詳，本戰的戰史因此只能從事件的外圍重建。隋方可以確定的是沒有留下統一名將的指揮痕跡：從江都發出的詔令往往只指定郡縣就地抵抗，中央將領的姓名與所部兵數在不同文獻裡互有出入。真正構成背景的，是與他同時起兵的另外幾位首領：江淮的杜伏威以「吳王」之號割據，吳郡的沈法興稱梁，河北的竇建德建夏，瓦崗的李密與李子通各據一方；而長安方面，唐國公李淵已在大業十三年十一月起兵，隋帝本人則在次年被宇文化及弒於遼西。張善安在這個盤根錯節的棋局裡並非主角，他的意義在於把江右的鄉里武裝第一次編成了有旗號、有官署的政權形狀，也讓隋廷第一次認真地感到長江中游的防線需要一支能自專的部隊。
peopleEn: Few people left a name in this rising. What survives of Zhang Shan'an himself amounts to a handful of sentences: he rose in the Poyang region, took Xunyang, proclaimed himself dudu, a military governor, set up an administration and re-ordered the local order. Sui historians habitually called armed bands of this kind "bandits", and the records survive as brief notices threaded through miscellaneous entries and annals rather than as biography, so his origins, his age and the immediate motive for the revolt are all obscure; the campaign has to be reconstructed from the event's surroundings. On the Sui side no single commanding general dominates the record: the edicts sent out from Jiangdu generally named only the local officials and told them to resist, and the names and troop numbers of the central commanders differ from text to text. What really forms the background are the other leaders rising in the same years: Du Fuwei, who called himself King of Wu in Jianghuai; Shen Faxing, who took the title of Liang in Wu prefecture; Dou Jiande, who founded Xia in Hebei; Li Mi at Wagang and Li Zitong each holding their own ground; and in Chang'an, the Duke of Tang Li Yuan, who had raised troops in the eleventh month of the same year, while the Sui emperor himself was killed at Liaoxi the following year. Zhang Shan'an was not the central figure in that tangled board. His significance lies in having turned the armed villagers of the right bank into something shaped like a state — a banner, a set of offices, a place where grain and rank could be distributed — and in forcing the court to acknowledge that the middle Yangtze needed a force allowed to act on its own.
kits: 卡面這件斯巴達長矛是公元前五世紀希臘重裝步兵方陣的標誌：兩米長的木槍，槍尾帶銅套，正面衝鋒時靠密集的槍林與重甲盾牆頂住對方的衝撞，槍尾的銅套則在地面上撐住長槍、承受後推的力道。它沒有出現在這場江右起義裡，但它所代表的兵種位置在中國同樣存在：隋軍的骨幹是步槊與長槊方陣，陌刀與長刀在旁掩護，弓弩手壓制射界，披明光鎧的重裝步兵頂在最前，鎬、盾與橫刀補在側翼；水軍方面有沿長江巡邏的鬥艦，以及為征高句麗而造的五牙大艦，舳艫相接可達二百餘艘，封鎖江面是其最有效的手段。起義軍這邊的裝備明顯簡陋得多：鄉民取竹為槊，削尖了就是步槊，標槍用現成木料，戈與叉來自農具與漁具，柴刀與扁擔改成短兵器，銅鐵甲胄只在小首領身上見得到，弓弩多為自製小弓與舊式弩，素無攻城器械，遇城只能靠夜襲與內應。兩個體系在長槍這一點上其實同源：斯巴達人用兩米木槍，江西鄉兵用竹槊，同樣是站在最前面、用密集的槍線去頂住人流與衝鋒。
kitsEn: The dory on the card face is the emblem of the fifth-century BCE Greek hoplite phalanx: a wooden shaft about two metres long with a bronze butt spike, carried so that a dense forest of points met the charge, the spike taking the shock when the line was driven back and braced against the ground. It was not present in this rising in Jiangxi, but the place it occupied in the order of battle existed in China too. The core of the Sui infantry was the phalanx of short thrusting spears and long pikes, with dao-chords and long swords working at the flanks, crossbow and bowmen covering the ground, armoured heavy infantry in the front rank, and axes, shields and sabres along the sides; on the water the Sui patrolled the Yangtze in fighting vessels and in the large five-toothed ships built for the campaigns against Goguryeo, which could be lashed side by side in some two hundred hulls to seal the river. The rebels' equipment was far poorer: bamboo cut into spears served as the pike, thrown javelins were made from whatever timber came to hand, halberds and tridents came from farm and fishing tools, billhooks and carrying poles were turned into side-arms, and bronze or iron armour was seen only on the smaller commanders, their bows mostly self-made and their crossbows old, with no siege engines at all — against a walled city they could only work by night assault and by men already inside. On the long spear the two systems were in fact of one kind: the Spartan held a two-metre wooden shaft, the Jiangxi villager a bamboo one, and both stood in the front rank, meeting a charge with a packed line of points.
tactics: 由於正史只留下結果而沒有留下戰鬥過程，這裡只能從地理、兵源與雙方武器的差距推想這場起義的可能打法。江右的特點是山湖相間：鄱陽湖西南、大庾嶺北麓與皖口一帶山嶺逼仄，郡城多設在可通船的渡口與水陸驛道交會處，這意味著水陸兩種補給線同時存在，誰控制渡口誰就控制節奏。鄉里起義的典型做法是憑藉血緣與地緣網絡迅速擴張，先以小股人馬夜襲小縣、奪取府庫，再順著山道與水面向郡城進逼；遇到大城則圍而不攻，改以封鎖糧道、招撫守軍為主，等隋軍主力一到就散入山野重整。作戰序列上，起義軍以步兵結陣，竹槊與標槍在前列，弓弩散在兩翼，靠地形的狹隘限制敵方騎兵展開；隋軍則反其道而行，據城固守、以強弩封住城門與橋頭，待敵疲於攻城時由披甲重步兵自城門反擊，或以水軍沿江截擊其糧船與援兵，並盡量以官銜、賞格與招安分化起義內部。史書未載此役的陣形細節，上述推想只作為背景說明，不宜當作定論。
tacticsEn: Because the official histories kept the outcome and dropped the fighting, the only way to reason about how this rising was fought is to work from the geography, the manpower and the gap between the two sides' weapons. The right bank is a land of hills and lakes: the ridges crowding the southwest of Lake Poyang, the northern slopes of the Daying Range and the bend at Wankou squeeze the country into narrow defiles, while the prefectural seats sit on river crossings where water and land roads meet — so there are two supply lines at once, and whoever holds the ferries sets the pace. Village risings of this kind spread fast on kinship and local ties: small bands would seize a small county by night, take its granaries, then press along mountain tracks and waterways toward the prefectural seat; before a large city they would besiege rather than assault, preferring to cut the grain road and talk the defenders over, and to disperse into the hills once the Sui main force arrived. In order of battle the rebels formed up on foot with bamboo pikes and javelins in front and bowmen on the flanks, using the narrow ground to deny the enemy room to deploy horse. The Sui did the opposite: they held the walled cities, kept strong crossbows on the gates and bridges, and when the attackers were worn down by the siege, sent armoured heavy infantry out of the gate to counterattack, or used the river fleet to cut the rebels' grain boats and reinforcements, while offering offices, bounties and amnesty to divide the rebels from within. The texts record no formation details for this campaign; the reconstruction above is background reasoning and should not be taken as settled fact.
data: 這場起義本身沒有留下可用的數字。現存記載既不載起義兵員，也不載攻城斬獲與隋軍損耗，連張善安聚眾的時間跨度都只能以隋末的整體年表去框定：大業十三年（617）冬起事，次年五月隋煬帝在遼西被弒，隋室崩解，618年唐國公李淵在長安即位，江右的割據局面又延續了數年才被平定。與這場起義同期、卻有數字可查的，是隋朝把整個國家推向極限的那些紀錄：大業八至大業十年間三次征高句麗，每次徵發兵員以百萬計，役使丁夫數十萬，江南一帶丁口大量外流；《隋書·食貨志》所述大業年間全國戶數已接近九百萬，卻要靠這樣的戶口去供應這樣的役使。地理上，從江都沿長江上溯至尋陽約七百里水路，隋軍若由運河北下或由江東調兵，都需要以月計的時間；自大庾嶺、廬山間的小路進兵，則是鄉兵最熟悉的通道。距離、耗時與兵源的這組關係，決定了起義方在游擊與固守之間必須不斷取捨，也決定了守城的一方只要守住渡口，就能讓進攻的一方自行耗盡。
dataEn: This rising left no usable numbers. The surviving records give neither the rebel strength nor the casualties, the captures or the Sui losses, and even the span of Zhang Shan'an's activity can only be framed against the Sui's own chronology: it began in the winter of 617, the thirteenth year of Daye; the Yangdi emperor was killed at Liaoxi the following May, the dynasty collapsed, Li Yuan of Tang took the throne at Chang'an in 618, and the rival regimes along the river would not be settled for several years more. What does carry numbers belongs to the crisis around this rising rather than to it: in the three campaigns against Goguryeo between the eighth and tenth years of Daye the Sui mustered troops by the hundred thousand and pressed tens of thousands of men into service as labour gangs, and the population of the south had been drained accordingly; the Sui histories record household numbers approaching nine million in the later Daye years, and those households were the base for those levies. Geographically, the water run from Jiangdu up to Xunyang is about seven hundred li, so an army coming down from the north or from Jiangdong needed months to arrive; the small tracks through the Daying Range and the Lu Mountains were the routes the village troops knew best. That combination of distance, time and supply decided the rebels' endless choice between raiding and holding, and it meant that a defending side which held the ferries only had to hold them for the attacking side to spend itself.
cause: 要理解張善安為何會在617年的江右舉兵，必須把視線放回隋朝崩解前夜的整體結構。煬帝連年南巡江都，北卻幽州，大軍久駐於京師與運河沿線，江北江南的郡兵在三次征高句麗中被大量抽調、耗散，歸返者寥寥，缺額多以逃亡與裁汰的形式消化。留在地方的丁口既要供租、供役，又要供應漕運與駐軍的消耗，饑饉與疫癘的消息在江右鄉里流傳已久。隋廷對地方的掌控這時只剩下稅收與名義，郡縣官府常靠本地豪強維持秩序，一旦中央的軍令與賞格無法兌現，郡兵與鄉里武裝便很容易被政治環境和生存壓力裹挾成新的軍事力量。張善安這類起義領袖所要的，通常不是精密的政治綱領，而是一個能讓流民、逃兵和欠身役者重新編組的旗號：一個都督的名分、一套可以分配糧食與職位的衙門，以及一次對尋陽這樣水路樞紐的奪取。因為長江中游的糧道與鹽利都在尋陽、鄱陽一帶，掌握鄱陽湖的出入口，就等於掌握了江南漕運的一半咽喉。
causeEn: To understand why Zhang Shan'an rose in Jiangxi in 617, the view has to widen to the whole structure of the Sui in its last months. The Yangdi emperor campaigned endlessly — south to Jiangdu, north to Youzhou — and his main armies sat for years in the capital and along the canal; the commandery troops of the north and the south had been drained by three campaigns against Goguryeo, and those who came back were few, the gaps being filled by flight and by discharge. The population left in the localities had to provide rent, provide labour, and supply the court and its armies; famine and epidemic had long been reported in the villages of the right bank. The court's hold on the provinces had by then narrowed to taxation and title, and the local administrations were kept in order by the great landowners themselves; once the court's orders and rewards could no longer be honoured, the commandery soldiers and village armed men were easily swept into new military formations by political collapse and the pressure of survival. What leaders like Zhang Shan'an sought was rarely a careful political programme, but a banner that could let refugees, deserters and men in arrears of service be reorganised: the standing of a dudu, offices that could allot grain and rank, and one seizure of a hub like Xunyang. Because the grain road and the salt traffic of the middle Yangtze both ran through Xunyang and Poyang, holding the exits of Lake Poyang meant holding half the throat of Jiangnan's transport.
impact: 這場起義的直接結果，是江右的郡縣在隋末的大崩解中先行失序，說明唐初史家所稱「隋亡之後，天下豪強各自爭據」的說法，在長江中游的表現比在北方更早也更亂。張善安佔領尋陽、置官屬的做法，為後來江右地區的割據提供了樣板：杜伏威的吳國、李子通的宋、沈法興的梁相繼在同一條交通線上建立政權，彼此攻殺的同時也把太湖、鄱陽兩湖水系的控制權變成爭奪的重點。對隋廷而言，這類起義的戰略意義大於戰術意義——它牽制了本已枯竭的江南兵源，迫使中央把僅有的將領與物資調往江右，而無力同時應對河北與河內的戰線。從更長的視角看，隋末唐初的江南平定，是由唐王朝在接下來的十餘年裡以水路推進與江南方鎮的連續用兵才逐步完成的，張善安這一線的失敗與消散，意味著地方武裝若沒有跨流域的聯盟、穩定的糧源與能延續的號令，很難把一次成功的起義轉成持久的政權；同一時期真正站住腳跟的，都是那些把軍事行動與鹽、漕、江防綁在一起，並最終選擇歸附新朝號令的一方。
impactEn: The immediate effect of the rising was that the prefectures of the right bank lost their order early in the Sui collapse, showing that the Tang historians' phrase about powerful men contending over the realm after the fall of Sui was already true along the middle Yangtze earlier, and more disorderly, than in the north. Zhang Shan'an's seizure of Xunyang and his installation of officials supplied a model for the regimes that followed on the same transport line: the state of Wu of Du Fuwei, the Song of Li Zitong and the Liang of Shen Faxing each built their authority along this corridor, and their mutual wars turned control of the water systems of Taihu and Poyang into the central prize. For the Sui court the strategic meaning of such risings exceeded their tactical meaning: they tied down an already exhausted southern manpower and forced the centre to send its few commanders and supplies toward the right bank, unable to fight on the Hebei and Henei fronts at once. In the longer view, the pacification of Jiangnan under the Tang was only completed over the following decade as the southern commands advanced by water and by river roads, and the dispersal of Zhang Shan'an's line showed that a local armed force without inter-basin alliances, stable supply and a command that could outlast a defeat could not turn a successful rising into a durable regime. The men who did endure in those years were those who tied their fighting to salt, grain transport and river defence, and who eventually chose to submit to the new dynasty's orders.
result: 結局是起義失敗。隋廷的追討最終收復了尋陽、鄱陽一線，起義軍失去根據地，部眾或散還鄉里，或被編入官軍與其他割據勢力，張善安本人的下落則各書說法不一：有記他兵敗被誅的，也有記他於隋亡之後率眾歸附唐室的，還有記他在混戰中不知所終的；現存材料不足以判定，只能存疑。從大局看，這場起義並沒有改變江右的權力歸屬，它只把一條被隋末亂局撕開的裂縫留在鄱陽湖周邊，隨後被杜伏威、李子通與唐朝的江南方鎮一一收拾。真正確定的結局是隋朝本身：617年的起義潮、618年江都的政變與遼西的弒君，讓中央的權威在一年之內全部失效，張善安的戰線不過是這場全國性崩解在長江中游的一個切面。若就兵裝而言，則如卡面所示——斯巴達長矛並未出現在江西的江畔，但它所象徵的「以密集長槍守住陣線」的信念，在隋軍的步槊方陣與鄉兵的竹槊裡，同樣真實地存在過。
resultEn: The rising failed. The court's counterattack eventually retook the Xunyang and Poyang line; the rebels lost their base area, and their men either dispersed home, were absorbed into government troops, or were taken in by other contending powers. Zhang Shan'an's own fate is recorded inconsistently: some accounts have him killed after the defeat, others have him leading his followers to submit to the Tang after the fall of the Sui, and others lose track of him entirely in the fighting. The surviving material is not enough to decide, so the point must remain open. In the larger picture the rising changed nothing about who would rule the right bank; it only left a torn seam around Lake Poyang for Du Fuwei, Li Zitong and the Tang's southern commands to pick clean in turn. What is certain is the fate of the Sui itself: the risings of 617, the coup at Jiangdu and the killing of the emperor at Liaoxi in 618 destroyed the central authority within a single year, and Zhang Shan'an's front was only one facet of that national collapse on the middle Yangtze. On the subject of arms, the card says what needs saying: the dory never stood on the Jiangxi bank, but the belief it stands for — holding the line with a packed front of long spears — was just as real in the pike phalanx of the Sui army and the bamboo pikes of the village bands.
